units.titles: [C-02] Wrong‑Offset Ed25519 instruction introspection enables forged approvals
units.known_address_notes: Report: repository Enclave-Money/solver-fund-pool-anchor @668adb2e (Anchor program, 'Enclave is a Solana program that provides a fund pool allowing users to borrow tokens instantly with off-chain authorization'). GitHub API: repo = 404, so the Anchor.toml declare_id / program keypair is not readable. enclave.money resolves but renders no content (no docs, no program id). No program id was published in the report -> PARTIAL.

units.titles: Incorrect Native Token Handling in Deposit Function
units.known_address_notes: Cantina PDF identifies the product as Ludex ('Ludex simplifies blockchain integration for game developers... Challenge protocol'), using Pyth Entropy for randomness and referral registration. ludex.gg / dashboard.ludex.gg / ludexlabs.com publish no contract addresses; the public ludexdev/ludex-contract repo is an unrelated EtherVista DEX fork (EtherVistaFactory/Pair/Router), not the Challenge contracts. No audited address located -> PARTIAL.

Report: repo curio-research/flagship-contracts @25a268fd (Game creation/settlement contract, 'winner's payout' C-02), no address and no chain stated. GitHub API: curio-research/flagship-contracts = 404 (deleted/private); the remaining org repos (demo-contracts, gevm, keystone, keystone-starter-kit, treaty-contracts, treaty-vault) are engine/keystone code with no deployment manifest; curio.gg publishes no contract addresses and the studio runs games on its own game server with no public explorer.
